pages.title: Merck's Rhinoceros
pages.text: The Merck's rhinoceros ($(o)Stephanorhinus kirchbergensis$()) is an extinct rhinoceros that lived across Eurasia, from western Europe to East Asia, during the Middle and Late Pleistocene.$(br2)It was a large two-horned rhino that mainly browsed on trees and shrubs.$(br2)It favoured temperate woodlands and was most widespread in Europe during warm interglacial periods. Its closest relatives include the woolly rhinoceros and the living Sumatran rhinoceros.
